purpose: Development-only test of whether reviewed 2>0 preferences transfer across disjoint issue families
method: Frozen E5 diagonal bilinear score residual, ridge regression on explicit pairwise margins
training: Only the 27 existing high-confidence grade 2 > grade 0 preferences; equal total weight per anchor; no in-batch negatives
validation: Leave one connected issue component out, including all original proposal triples and all reviewed edges; no issue may cross folds
comparison: Unchanged production hybrid versus same hybrid with learned dense score; same corpus, prefixes, candidate budget and BM25
metrics: Known positive recall@10/@100; judged-only nDCG; known grade-0 exposure@10 and annotation coverage; macro explicit preference accuracy
go_no_go: Research candidate only if mean known R@10 improves, no component loses known R@10, mean R@100 does not fall and held-out preference accuracy improves. Even passing does not authorize claiming an independent test win.
no_tuning: One fixed setting. Do not sweep or retune on these outcomes. Do not touch protected test labels, model weights or production configuration.
latency: Measure cached-vector search only; excludes embedding inference and is not end-to-end latency
